reason: This is a user-facing UI interaction plugin that customizes right-click behavior in the DeepSeek Harness workspace UI to provide context actions for workspace/session rows, blank-area menus, and text-edit areas, while delegating actions through host APIs. The evidence is explicit about menu replacement and available operations, so the classification is navigation-focused UI enhancement with moderate risk due to user-triggered rename/delete/archive actions and host integration paths.

summaries.zh: 本插件用于定制 DeepSeek Harness 的右键菜单，在工作区/会话界面、空白区域和可编辑文本中提供本地化的操作入口，如新建、重命名、分叉与归档等。
summaries.en: This plugin customizes DeepSeek Harness right-click behavior in workspace/session UI, blank areas, and editable text zones to provide direct action menus such as create, rename, fork, archive, and text edit/search commands.

capabilities: custom contextmenu handling in targeted UI areas
workspace/session action invocation via host GUI APIs
launching external browser/file-open paths through host integration

reasons.code: Readme describes replacing native right-click behavior on workspace rows, session rows, blank areas, and text fields with plugin-provided menus.

Readme lists destructive/altering operations (rename/delete workspace, rename/fork/archive session) executed through GUI/API routes such as workspace.rename, workspace.delete, session.rename, session.fork, workspace.archiveSession.
Package manifest declares dsh.bundle patch-based web injection, and dev client injection for @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace.
